visual_records.analytical_purpose: Expose the paper's dependency route before the formula sections.
visual_records.exact_reading: The Summary moves from three graphs to dynamic churn, cost-minimizing genetic assignment, Tasks 3-5, local GA settings, and a proposed information layer.
visual_records.next_action: Bind every promised result to a state, scenario and evidence boundary.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Separate friendship-like social influence from formal position.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 1 represents people as nodes and their relationship as edges before leadership is introduced.
visual_records.next_action: Release edge definitions, direction and measurement source.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Show two churn causes before combining them.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 2 labels the personal loyalty and pairwise intimacy quantities in a time-indexed people network.
visual_records.next_action: Estimate both quantities from consented longitudinal evidence.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Give transition multipliers a position domain.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 3 displays the six salary-defined position levels and permitted hierarchy moves.
visual_records.next_action: Release the actual hierarchy and movement rules.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Make assignment eligibility and decision separate.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 4 distinguishes person and level nodes, possible assignments, a chosen HR edge and an under-training virtual state.
visual_records.next_action: Release eligibility, capacity and assignment-cost data.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Show exactly what is integrated before time is added.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 5 puts people, positions and assignment relations into one snapshot.
visual_records.next_action: Version all three edge sets and snapshot timing.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Turn the static network into an event sequence.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 6 stacks monthly network layers to make people, positions and matches change over time.
visual_records.next_action: Freeze state-update order and event timestamps.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Connect a local move to a multiplier rather than a general morale claim.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 7 accompanies same-position and position-adjustment loyalty rules, including the composed skipped move.
visual_records.next_action: Calibrate T and test path dependence.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Give the ratio formula a concrete level scale.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 8 and Table 1 tie six salary levels to the old/new position-gap rule for intimacy.
visual_records.next_action: Validate whether hierarchy distance predicts relationship change.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Make the matrix handoff inspectable.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 9 works a four-position, two-employee assignment through the loyalty update and reports 0.9785 and 0.9384.
visual_records.next_action: Publish T, A and the exact rounding policy.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Show the loop that gives the GA an intervention point.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 10 connects current loyalty/intimacy, churn, recruitment and HR adjustment in the dynamic HCN.
visual_records.next_action: Release monthly events, graph refresh and authority rules.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Explain why missing output data changes the optimization objective.
visual_records.exact_reading: Displayed expressions separate staffing output from structural loss and split total cost into structural, salary, training and recruitment components.
visual_records.next_action: Validate output and cost units against observed organizational outcomes.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Make the genetic representation auditable.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 2 and Figure 11 map 0, 1-6, N and D to training, levels, absence and departure.
visual_records.next_action: Release capacities, initial population and chromosome traces.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Expose domain restrictions inside the generic GA.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 12 restricts mutation/crossover to promotion; Figure 13 draws the iteration termination flow.
visual_records.next_action: Test feasibility, quality and excluded demotion/firing alternatives.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Show which downstream step re-enters the network.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 14 places loyalty/intimacy change, churn/recruitment simulation and GA assignment in the three-part circular process.
visual_records.next_action: Record the interface data and loop stopping rule.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Compress a monthly trace into a bounded budget claim.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 3 records own/following churn, recruitment and cumulative costs over 24 months, ending at 38.2 sigma recruitment and 127.08 sigma training.
visual_records.next_action: Publish all runs, cost provenance and uncertainty.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Read the non-monotone direct-cost curve under a fixed staffing target.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 4 and Figure 15 report recruitment needed to sustain 80% fill and direct cost, including 25% churn/22% recruitment/617.64 sigma and 35%/31%/533.66 sigma.
visual_records.next_action: Keep direct cost separate from structural stability.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Preserve the direct-indirect tradeoff and bounded region decision.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figures 16 and 17 show rising structural cost and categorize churn-recruitment combinations by fill and structure status.
visual_records.next_action: Repeat the grid with capacity constraints and uncertainty.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Ground the health claim in level-specific flows.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 5 gives two-year churn, promotions, recruitment and ending headcount by level for elevated junior-manager and experienced-supervisor churn.
visual_records.next_action: Measure actual promotion quality, wellbeing and retention.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Keep tuning local and controlled.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figures 18 and 19 show an apparent iteration plateau and rate sweeps used to select K=2000, MR=0.4 and CR=0.1.
visual_records.next_action: Release seeds, repeated sweeps and a decision tolerance.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Mark an omitted mechanism as a conceptual extension.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 20 adds information beside relationship and position networks after the prior simulation has stopped.
visual_records.next_action: Define measured information edges and coupling before use.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: End at missing structures rather than turning extensions into results.
visual_records.exact_reading: The paper proposes department-aware loyalty, intimacy and capacity changes, then names assumption dependence and graph-table mismatch as weaknesses.
visual_records.next_action: Carry both source weaknesses into any reuse.
